en: Black-and-white street view showing Piersonstraat in Nijmegen. Brick row houses and small businesses line both sides of a cobblestone street. Garlands or festoons are strung across the street overhead, suggesting a celebration or holiday. Several adults and children are walking or standing in the street; one child has a bicycle. The overall scene has an early-20th-century European urban atmosphere. In the lower left corner, white caption text identifies the location as 'NIJMEGEN, PIERSONSTRAAT'. On the right, a shop sign is visible above a doorway.
